title: Order one pepperoni + jalapeño pizza for delivery
description: Create an agent that can successfully order a pizza with the specified requirements for delivery.

constraints.goal: get a qualifying pizza delivered as quickly as possible
constraints.vendor_restrictions: Any legitimate restaurant or food-delivery website may be used
constraints.order_limit: Never place more than one order
constraints.security: Never bypass CAPTCHA, MFA, authentication, access controls, or payment security

success_criteria.primary: Pizza with pepperoni and jalapeño toppings is ordered and confirmed for delivery
secondary: Total cost including delivery fees and taxes does not exceed $35
Order is placed through legitimate means without security bypasses
